caption: The drawing shows a cylindrical tin container with a slightly conical top and a small, flat lid. The main body of the container is painted black with areas that appear worn or scratched, revealing some underlying material. There are decorative motifs painted on the surface, featuring two large floral or leaf shapes in shades of yellow and green, with two round, orange-red forms resembling fruit or flowers. Around the upper sloped part of the container, there is a horizontal row of short, curved leaf-like shapes in greenish-yellow. The lid also has a smaller version of this motif with two leaf-like shapes in the same color. The base is bordered by a thin yellow line. The container stands upright against a plain, light-colored background with the artist's signature, “C. Herring,” in the lower left corner.
title: Toleware Tea Caddy
